mechanism: The July descent from ~20 to a shelf near 17.7 inflicted only a single channel death (08-12), and the field's stability re-knit immediately afterward (S_UF 0.80 back to 0.90-0.93) while price flattened. Two full sessions of sustained upward displacement were held against the flat shelf, and when displacement flipped negative on 08-19 with unresolved force draining 0.57 to 0.42 into the close, the shelf absorbed it with no new low, no deaths, and no dead channels. Damage is old and healed; the residual downward push is being conducted through an intact, re-knit base rather than breaking new structure.
